title: Sog‘liq: shifokorda va dorixonada
goal_uz: Dars oxirida tana a’zolarini va simptomlarni nomlaysiz, have va hurts bilan muammoingizni tushuntirasiz, should va must bilan maslahatni tushunasiz hamda dorixonada dori so‘rab, ichish tartibini tushunasiz.

scenes.title: Shifokorda va dorixonada
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda orttirma darajani o‘rgandik: the best, the biggest. Bugun juda zarur mavzu, sog‘liq. Kasal bo‘lib qolsangiz, chet elda shifokorga yoki dorixonaga borishingiz mumkin. Dars oxirida qayeringiz og‘riyotganini tushuntirasiz, shifokor maslahatini tushunasiz va dorixonada dori so‘rab olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today's topic is health. You will learn to explain a problem at the doctor's and in the pharmacy.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugungi mavzu sog‘liq. Shifokorda va dorixonada muammoingizni tushuntirishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Tana a’zolari: bosh qismi
scenes.say_native: Avval tana a’zolarini bilib olamiz. Boshdan boshlaymiz: head — bosh, eye — ko‘z, ear — quloq, nose — burun, mouth — og‘iz, tooth — tish, throat — tomoq, neck — bo‘yin. Diqqat: tooth ko‘plikda teeth bo‘ladi, tooths emas. Bu noto‘g‘ri ko‘plik shakli, uni yodlab oling. Ko‘z va quloq odatda juft bo‘lgani uchun eyes va ears ko‘plikda ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Head, eye, ear, nose, mouth, tooth, teeth, throat, neck.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh, ko‘z, quloq, burun, og‘iz, tish, tishlar, tomoq, bo‘yin.

scenes.title: Tana a’zolari: tana va oyoq-qo‘l
scenes.say_native: Davom etamiz. Shoulder — yelka, arm — qo‘l tirsakkacha, hand — kaft, finger — barmoq, chest — ko‘krak, back — bel yoki orqa, stomach — qorin, me’da, leg — oyoq sondan pastgacha, knee — tizza, foot — tovon va kaft osti, ko‘plikda feet. O‘zbekchada qo‘l va oyoq bitta so‘z, inglizchada arm bilan hand, leg bilan foot alohida. Stomach so‘zi ch bilan yoziladi, lekin k tovushi bilan o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: Shoulder, arm, hand, finger, chest, back, stomach, leg, knee, foot, feet.
scenes.say_uz: Yelka, qo‘l, kaft, barmoq, ko‘krak, bel, qorin, oyoq, tizza, oyoq kafti, oyoq kaftlari.

scenes.title: Inglizchasini ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Men o‘zbekcha so‘z aytaman, siz inglizchasini ayting. Tish. Tomoq. Tizza. Qorin. Tishning ko‘plik shaklini ham eslang. Tayyormisiz? Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Tooth. Throat. Knee. Stomach. Now the plural of tooth.
scenes.say_uz: Tish. Tomoq. Tizza. Qorin. Endi tishning ko‘pligi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tana a’zolari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Tish — tooth. Tomoq — throat. Tizza — knee, bu yerda k harfi o‘qilmaydi, ni deb o‘qiladi. Qorin — stomach. Va tishlar — teeth. Agar knee so‘zini kni deb o‘qigan bo‘lsangiz, bu juda tabiiy xato, ingliz tilida bu so‘zning boshidagi k tovushsiz.
scenes.say: Tooth. Throat. Knee. Stomach. Teeth.
scenes.say_uz: Tish. Tomoq. Tizza. Qorin. Tishlar.

scenes.title: Kasallik belgilari
board: a headache, a toothache, a stomach ache
a cold, a cough, a fever
a sore throat, a runny nose
scenes.say_native: Endi simptomlar. Og‘riq nomlari a’zo nomiga ache qo‘shib yasaladi: headache — bosh og‘rig‘i, toothache — tish og‘rig‘i, stomach ache — qorin og‘rig‘i. Boshqa belgilar: a cold — shamollash, a cough — yo‘tal, a fever yoki a temperature — isitma, a sore throat — tomoq og‘rig‘i, a runny nose — burundan suv oqishi. Hammasi odatda a bilan keladi.
scenes.say: A headache. A toothache. A cold. A cough. A fever. A sore throat. A runny nose.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh og‘rig‘i. Tish og‘rig‘i. Shamollash. Yo‘tal. Isitma. Tomoq og‘rig‘i. Burundan suv oqishi.

scenes.title: I have + simptom
scenes.say_native: Kasallik haqida aytishning eng oddiy usuli: I have yoki I’ve got, keyin a va simptom nomi. I have a headache. She has a fever. Savol uchun do ni ishlatamiz: do you have a cough? Britaniya ingliz tilida I’ve got ko‘proq eshitiladi. Amerikaliklar odatda I have deydi. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri va ma’nosi bir xil.
scenes.say: I have a headache. I've got a cold. She has a fever. Do you have a cough?
scenes.say_uz: Boshim og‘riyapti. Shamollaganman. Uning isitmasi bor. Yo‘talingiz bormi?

scenes.title: Hurt bilan gaplar
board: Where does it hurt? — It hurts here.
I have a pain in my back.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi usul: hurt fe’li, ya’ni og‘rimoq. Tuzilishi: my, a’zo nomi, hurts. My head hurts. Ko‘plik bo‘lsa, fe’lda s tushadi: my legs hurt. Qayeri og‘rishini so‘rash uchun: where does it hurt? Javob: it hurts here. Yana bir qolip: I have a pain in my back, ya’ni belimda og‘riq bor. Pain dan keyin in my bilan joyni ko‘rsatamiz.
scenes.say: My head hurts. My legs hurt. Where does it hurt? It hurts here.
scenes.say_uz: Boshim og‘riyapti. Oyoqlarim og‘riyapti. Qayeringiz og‘riyapti? Mana shu yer og‘riyapti.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan farq
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada boshim og‘riyapti deymiz, egalik qo‘shimchasi so‘z ichida, boshim. Inglizchada esa egalikni alohida so‘z bilan aytamiz: my head. The head deb aytmang. Yana bir farq: o‘zbekchada bitta fe’l og‘rimoq ham, og‘riq ham bor. Inglizchada ikki xil qolip: ot bilan have a headache, fe’l bilan my head hurts. Ikkalasini ham bilish kerak.
scenes.say: In Uzbek the possessive is in the word. In English you say my head hurts.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekchada egalik so‘z ichida. Inglizchada my head hurts deysiz.

scenes.title: Tipik xatolar: og‘riq
board: ✗ I have headache. / ✗ I am headache.
✗ My head hurt. / ✗ The head hurts.
✓ I have a headache. My head hurts. My legs hurt.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoga e’tibor bering. Birinchi: a ni tashlab ketish, I have headache, yoki to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri I am headache deyish. To‘g‘risi I have a headache. Ikkinchi: egalikni unutish, the head hurts. Uchinchi: ko‘plik bilan hurts, my legs hurts. Ko‘plik bo‘lsa fe’lda s yo‘q, my legs hurt. Yakka a’zo uchun hurts, ko‘plik uchun hurt.
scenes.say: I have a headache. My head hurts. My legs hurt.
scenes.say_uz: Boshim og‘riyapti. Boshim og‘riyapti. Oyoqlarim og‘riyapti.

scenes.title: Rasm bo‘yicha gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta holat. Birinchi: bosh og‘riyapti. Ikkinchi: oyoqlar og‘riyapti. Uchinchi: yo‘tal va isitma bor. To‘rtinchi: tish og‘riyapti. Har bir holat uchun inglizcha gap ayting. Birinchi ikkitasida hurt dan, qolganlarida have dan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Head. Legs. Cough and fever. Tooth. Make a sentence for each.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh. Oyoqlar. Yo‘tal va isitma. Tish. Har biri uchun gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: simptomlar
board: I have a cough and a fever.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. My head hurts. My legs hurt. I have a cough and a fever. I have a toothache. Boshqa to‘g‘ri variantlar ham bor, masalan I have a headache va my tooth hurts. Ikkala qolip ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz topshiriqni uddaladingiz.
scenes.say: My head hurts. My legs hurt. I have a cough and a fever. I have a toothache.
scenes.say_uz: Boshim og‘riyapti. Oyoqlarim og‘riyapti. Yo‘talim va isitmam bor. Tishim og‘riyapti.

scenes.title: Feel bilan: his-tuyg‘u
board: British: ill = kasal; sick = qusgisi kelmoq
scenes.say_native: Feel fe’li bilan holatingizni aytasiz: I feel sick, I feel dizzy, I feel tired, I don’t feel well. Britaniya ingliz tilida ill umumiy kasallikni bildiradi, sick esa ko‘pincha qusgisi kelishini. Shuning uchun I feel sick degani, qusgim kelyapti. Amerika ingliz tilida esa sick umuman kasal degani. Feel dan keyin sifat keladi, masalan sick yoki tired.
scenes.say: I feel sick. I feel dizzy. I don't feel well. I'm ill.
scenes.say_uz: Qusgim kelyapti. Boshim aylanyapti. O‘zimni yaxshi his qilmayapman. Men kasalman.

scenes.title: Qabulga yozilish
board: I'd like to make an appointment.
I need to see a doctor.
Can I come today at three?

examples.t: I would like to make an appointment.
I need to see a doctor today.

scenes.say_native: Shifokorga borishdan oldin ko‘pincha qabulga yoziladi. Foydali iboralar: I’d like to make an appointment, ya’ni qabulga yozilmoqchiman. I need to see a doctor, shifokorga ko‘rinishim kerak. Can I come today at three? Bugun soat uchda kelsam bo‘ladimi? Britaniyada shifokorga borishni go to the doctor’s ham deyishadi.
scenes.say: I'd like to make an appointment. I need to see a doctor. Can I come today at three?
scenes.say_uz: Qabulga yozilmoqchiman. Shifokorga ko‘rinishim kerak. Bugun soat uchda kelsam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Shifokor savollari
scenes.say_native: Shifokor sizga odatda to‘rtta savol beradi. What’s the matter? Nima bo‘ldi? Where does it hurt? Qayeringiz og‘riyapti? When did it start? Qachon boshlandi? Are you allergic to anything? Biror narsaga allergiyangiz bormi? Javoblar: It started two days ago, ya’ni ikki kun oldin boshlandi. I’m allergic to penicillin, penitsillinga allergiyam bor. No, I’m not, ya’ni yo‘q, allergiyam yo‘q.
scenes.say: What's the matter? Where does it hurt? When did it start? Are you allergic to anything?
scenes.say_uz: Nima bo‘ldi? Qayeringiz og‘riyapti? Qachon boshlandi? Biror narsaga allergiyangiz bormi?

scenes.title: Shifokorga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Siz bemorsiz. Men shifokorman. Uchta savolga o‘z javobingizni ayting. Birinchisi: nima bo‘ldi? Ikkinchisi: qachon boshlandi? Uchinchisi: allergiyangiz bormi? Masalan, boshim og‘riyapti, kecha boshlandi, allergiyam yo‘q. Ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: What's the matter? ... When did it start? ... Are you allergic to anything?
scenes.say_uz: Nima bo‘ldi? ... Qachon boshlandi? ... Allergiyangiz bormi?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. I have a headache. It started yesterday. No, I’m not. Agar allergiyangiz bo‘lsa, I’m allergic to bilan boshlang, masalan penicillin yoki nuts. Muhim: shifokorga allergiya haqida aytish xavfsizlik uchun juda kerak, shuning uchun bu iborani yaxshi yodlang.
scenes.say: I have a headache. It started yesterday. No, I'm not.
scenes.say_uz: Boshim og‘riyapti. Kecha boshlandi. Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Dialog: shifokorda
board: Patient: I have a sore throat and a cough.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Bemor shifokorga keldi. Tinglab, uchta savolga javob toping: bemorning muammolari nima, qachon boshlangan va shifokor unga nima qilmaslikni aytdi. Dialog tugagach, mashq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Doctor: Good morning. What's the matter? Patient: I have a sore throat and a cough. Doctor: When did it start? Patient: Three days ago. And I have a temperature. Doctor: Open your mouth, please. It looks like a bad cold. You should stay at home and drink a lot of water. You mustn't go to work for two days.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor: Xayrli tong. Nima bo‘ldi? Bemor: Tomog‘im og‘riyapti va yo‘talim bor. Shifokor: Qachon boshlandi? Bemor: Uch kun oldin. Isitmam ham bor. Shifokor: Og‘zingizni oching. Qattiq shamollashga o‘xshaydi. Uyda qoling va ko‘p suv iching. Ikki kun ishga bormang.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: bemorning qanday muammolari bor? Ikkinchi: qachon boshlangan? Uchinchi: u nima qilishi mumkin emas? To‘liq gap bilan ayting, masalan: he has a sore throat.
scenes.say: What problems does he have? When did it start? What mustn't he do?
scenes.say_uz: Uning qanday muammolari bor? Qachon boshlangan? U nima qilmasligi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog
board: 1) a sore throat, a cough, a temperature
3) go to work for two days
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bemorda tomoq og‘rig‘i, yo‘tal va isitma bor. Bu uch kun oldin boshlangan. Shifokor ikki kun ishga bormaslikni aytdi: he mustn’t go to work. Ko‘rdingizmi, shifokor ikki xil maslahat berdi: should bilan oddiy maslahat, mustn’t bilan qat’iy taqiq. Hozir buni batafsil ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: He has a sore throat, a cough and a temperature. It started three days ago. He mustn't go to work.
scenes.say_uz: Uning tomog‘i og‘riydi, yo‘tali va isitmasi bor. Uch kun oldin boshlangan. U ishga bormasligi kerak.

scenes.title: Should: maslahat
board: You should rest. (siz dam olishingiz kerak)
scenes.say_native: Shifokor maslahat berganda should ishlatadi. Tuzilishi: should, keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli, to siz. You should rest, you should drink more water. Inkori shouldn’t: you shouldn’t eat spicy food. Should hamma shaxs uchun bir xil, she should, he should, s qo‘shilmaydi. Ma’nosi o‘zbekcha sizga yaxshi bo‘lardi, kerak yoki ma’qul.
scenes.say: You should rest. You should drink more water. You shouldn't eat spicy food.
scenes.say_uz: Dam olishingiz kerak. Ko‘proq suv ichishingiz kerak. Achchiq ovqat yemasligingiz kerak.

scenes.title: Shifokor maslahatlari

examples.t: You should stay in bed for two days.

scenes.say_native: Mana oddiy maslahatlar. Ikki kun to‘shakda yoting. Tish shifokoriga ko‘rining. Bugun tashqariga chiqmang. Bu gaplarning hammasi should yoki shouldn’t bilan qurilgan. Savol shakli: should I stay in bed? Ya’ni should gap boshiga chiqadi, do kerak emas.
scenes.say: You should stay in bed for two days. You should see a dentist. You shouldn't go out today. Should I stay in bed?
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kun to‘shakda yoting. Tish shifokoriga ko‘rining. Bugun tashqariga chiqmang. To‘shakda yotishim kerakmi?

scenes.title: Must: qat’iy zarurat

examples.t: You mustn't take this with alcohol.
examples.uz: Buni spirtli ichimlik bilan ichmaslik kerak.

scenes.say_native: Must should dan kuchliroq. Should oddiy maslahat, must esa juda muhim, deyarli buyruq. You must see a doctor, shifokorga ko‘rinishingiz shart. Muhim farq: mustn’t taqiqni bildiradi, ya’ni bu qilinmasligi kerak. You mustn’t drive, siz mashina haydamasligingiz kerak. Must dan keyin ham to kelmaydi. Shifokorlar xavfli holatlarda must ishlatadi.
scenes.say: You must see a doctor. You mustn't drive. You must stop smoking.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokorga ko‘rinishingiz shart. Mashina haydamang. Chekishni tashlashingiz shart.

scenes.title: Should va must da xato
board: ✗ He shoulds rest. / ✗ You musts go.
✓ You should rest. He should rest.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni eslab qoling. Birinchi: should dan keyin to qo‘yish. Ikkinchi: shaxsga qarab s qo‘shish, he shoulds. Modal fe’llar o‘zgarmaydi. Uchinchi: should dan keyin ing shaklini ishlatish. Doim fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi, you should rest. Bu o‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan xato, chunki biz kerak so‘zidan oldin fe’lni turlaymiz.
scenes.say: You should rest. He should rest. You must go. No to, no s.
scenes.say_uz: Dam olishingiz kerak. U dam olishi kerak. Borishingiz shart. To ham, s ham yo‘q.

scenes.title: Maslahat bering
scenes.say_native: Siz shifokorsiz. Uchta bemorga maslahat bering. Birinchisining boshi og‘riyapti. Ikkinchisining tishi og‘riyapti. Uchinchisida yo‘tal va isitma bor. Har biriga should yoki shouldn’t bilan maslahat ayting. Agar xavfli bo‘lsa, must ham ishlating.
scenes.say: Give advice. A headache. A toothache. A cough and a fever. Use should.
scenes.say_uz: Maslahat bering. Bosh og‘rig‘i. Tish og‘rig‘i. Yo‘tal va isitma. Should dan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Mumkin bo‘lgan maslahatlar
board: You should take a painkiller and rest.
You should stay in bed and drink water.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar. Bosh og‘rig‘iga: you should take a painkiller and rest. Tish og‘rig‘iga: you should see a dentist. Yo‘tal va isitmaga: you should stay in bed and drink a lot of water. Siz boshqa maslahat bergan bo‘lsangiz ham, should dan keyin oddiy fe’l ishlatilgan bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: You should take a painkiller and rest. You should see a dentist. You should stay in bed.
scenes.say_uz: Og‘riq qoldiruvchi ichib, dam oling. Tish shifokoriga ko‘rining. To‘shakda yoting.

scenes.title: Dorixona: dori turlari
scenes.say_native: Dorixona inglizchada pharmacy, Britaniyada chemist’s ham deyiladi, Amerikada drugstore. Dori turlari: tablets — tabletkalar, capsules — kapsulalar, syrup — sirop, cream — surtma, drops — tomchi dori, painkillers — og‘riq qoldiruvchi dorilar. Antibiotics — antibiotiklar, ular faqat prescription, ya’ni shifokor retsepti bilan beriladi. Pill so‘zi ham tabletka ma’nosida eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Tablets. Capsules. Syrup. Cream. Drops. Painkillers. A prescription.
scenes.say_uz: Tabletkalar. Kapsulalar. Sirop. Surtma. Tomchilar. Og‘riq qoldiruvchilar. Retsept.

scenes.title: Dorixonada so‘rash
board: Do you have anything for a cough?
I'd like something for a headache.
Could I have some painkillers, please?

examples.t: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
Could I have some cough syrup, please?

scenes.say_native: Dorixonada ikki foydali qolip bor. Do you have anything for, keyin kasallik: do you have anything for a cough? Va I’d like something for a headache. Anything for va something for, ya’ni biror narsa, degan ma’noni beradi va farmatsevt o‘zi mos dorini tanlaydi. Aniq dori kerak bo‘lsa, could I have some painkillers, please? Please va could so‘zlari iltimosni muloyim qiladi.
scenes.say: Do you have anything for a cough? I'd like something for a headache. Could I have some painkillers, please?
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘talga biror dori bormi? Bosh og‘rig‘iga biror narsa bersangiz. Og‘riq qoldiruvchi bersangiz, iltimos.

scenes.title: Dorixonada tipik xatolar
board: ✗ Give me a medicine for cough.
✓ Do you have anything for a cough?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: o‘zbekchada dori ichmoq deymiz, shuning uchun drink medicine deydi. Inglizchada dori ichilmaydi, olinadi: take medicine, take a tablet. Faqat sirop yoki suyuqlikni ham take deymiz. Ikkinchisi: give me deb buyruq ohangida so‘rash, bu qo‘pol eshitiladi. Muloyim qolip: do you have anything for a cough yoki could I have, please.
scenes.say: Take medicine, not drink. Do you have anything for a cough? Could I have some tablets, please?
scenes.say_uz: Dori ichmang, take deng. Yo‘talga biror dori bormi? Tabletka bersangiz, iltimos.

scenes.title: Doza: necha marta, qachon
board: once / twice / three times a day

examples.t: Take one tablet twice a day.
examples.uz: Kuniga ikki marta bittadan tabletka iching.

examples.t: Take it after meals for five days.

scenes.say_native: Dorining ichish tartibi quyidagicha aytiladi. Once a day — kuniga bir marta, twice a day — ikki marta, three times a day — uch marta. Every six hours — har olti soatda. Before meals — ovqatdan oldin, after meals — ovqatdan keyin. For five days — besh kun davomida. Bu iboralar dori qutisida yozilgan bo‘ladi. Take bilan boshlanadi: take two tablets.
scenes.say: Take two tablets three times a day, after meals, for five days. Take one every six hours.
scenes.say_uz: Kuniga uch marta, ovqatdan keyin, besh kun davomida ikkitadan tabletka iching. Har olti soatda bittadan iching.

scenes.title: Yozuvni tushuning
board: Take two tablets twice a day after meals for five days.
scenes.say_native: Dori qutisidagi yozuvni tinglang va uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: nechta tabletka ichish kerak? Ikkinchi: kuniga necha marta? Uchinchi: qachon va necha kun? Yozuvni avval bir marta tinglab oling.
scenes.say: Take two tablets twice a day after meals for five days.
scenes.say_uz: Kuniga ikki marta, ovqatdan keyin, besh kun davomida ikkitadan tabletka iching.

scenes.title: Javoblar: yozuv
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ikkitadan tabletka. Kuniga ikki marta, ya’ni twice a day. Ovqatdan keyin, besh kun davomida. Kuniga jami to‘rtta tabletka ichiladi, ikki marta ikkitadan. Dori ichishda yozuvni diqqat bilan o‘qing. Tushunmasangiz, so‘rang: how often should I take it?
scenes.say: Two tablets. Twice a day. After meals, for five days.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita tabletka. Kuniga ikki marta. Ovqatdan keyin, besh kun.

scenes.title: Dialog: dorixonada
board: Customer: Do you have anything for a cough?
Pharmacist: Take two teaspoons three times a day.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog dorixonada. Mijoz yo‘talga dori so‘raydi. Tinglang va uchta savolga javob toping: mijozga nima kerak, dori kuniga necha marta ichiladi va qachon. Dialog oxirida narx ham aytiladi.
scenes.say: Pharmacist: Can I help you? Customer: Yes, do you have anything for a cough? Pharmacist: Is it a dry cough? Customer: Yes, and my throat hurts too. Pharmacist: Try this syrup. Take two teaspoons three times a day, after meals. Customer: How much is it? Pharmacist: Six pounds, please. Customer: Thank you. I'll take it.
scenes.say_uz: Farmatsevt: Yordam beraymi? Mijoz: Ha, yo‘talga biror dori bormi? Farmatsevt: Quruq yo‘talmi? Mijoz: Ha, tomog‘im ham og‘riyapti. Farmatsevt: Mana bu siropni sinab ko‘ring. Kuniga uch marta, ovqatdan keyin ikki choy qoshiqdan iching. Mijoz: Narxi qancha? Farmatsevt: Olti funt. Mijoz: Rahmat. Shuni olaman.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: mijozga nima kerak? Ikkinchi: dori kuniga necha marta ichiladi va qachon? Uchinchi: narxi qancha? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering va kerakli so‘zlarni eslang.
scenes.say: What does the customer need? How many times a day? How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: Mijozga nima kerak? Kuniga necha marta? Narxi qancha?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dorixona dialogi
board: 2) three times a day, after meals
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mijozga yo‘tal uchun dori kerak. Siropni kuniga uch marta, ovqatdan keyin, ikki choy qoshiqdan ichadi. Narxi olti funt. Ko‘rdingizmi, dialogda do you have anything for va take kabi o‘rgangan qoliplarimiz bor edi. Real vaziyatda ham shu iboralardan foydalanasiz.
scenes.say: The customer needs something for a cough. He takes it three times a day. It is six pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Mijozga yo‘tal uchun dori kerak. Uni kuniga uch marta ichadi. Narxi olti funt.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: qiyin so‘zlar
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsda talaffuzi qiyin so‘zlar ko‘p. Ache so‘zida ch harfi k tovushini beradi: eyk. Headache — hedeyk. Cough — kof, oxirida f tovushi, ough yozilishiga qaramang. Throat so‘zi th tovushidan boshlanadi, tilni tishlar orasiga qo‘ying. Stomach — stamak. Pharmacy — farmasi. Medicine Britaniyada ikki bo‘g‘inli, medsin.
scenes.say: Headache. Stomach. Cough. Throat. Pharmacy. Medicine.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh og‘rig‘i. Qorin. Yo‘tal. Tomoq. Dorixona. Dori.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Ache ni eyk deb aytishni unutmang. Cough so‘zining oxirida f. Throat da tilni tishlar orasiga qo‘ying. Pharmacy so‘zining birinchi bo‘g‘ini uzun a, urg‘u shu yerda. Sekin boshlang, keyin tezlashtiring.
scenes.say: Headache. Stomach ache. Cough. Throat. Pharmacy. Medicine.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh og‘rig‘i. Qorin og‘rig‘i. Yo‘tal. Tomoq. Dorixona. Dori.

scenes.title: Talaffuz bo‘yicha izoh
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Eslab qoling, ache so‘zida ch harfi hech qachon ch deb o‘qilmaydi. Cough oxiridagi f tovushi tomoqdan emas, lablar bilan aytiladi. Pharmacy so‘zida ph harflari f tovushini beradi, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Bu uch qoidani yodda tutsangiz, dorixonada tushunilmay qolmaysiz.
scenes.say: Ache. Cough. Pharmacy. Say them clearly.
scenes.say_uz: Ache. Cough. Pharmacy. Aniq ayting.

scenes.title: Bemor rolini o‘ynang
scenes.say_native: Asosiy vazifa. Siz bemorsiz. Shifokorga uchta simptomni ayting: bittasini have bilan, bittasini hurts bilan, va qachon boshlanganini. Keyin shifokordan nima qilish kerakligini so‘rang. Masalan: I have a cough, my head hurts, and it started yesterday. What should I do?
scenes.say: You are the patient. Tell the doctor three symptoms and when they started. Then ask: What should I do?
scenes.say_uz: Siz bemorsiz. Shifokorga uchta simptomni va qachon boshlanganini ayting. Keyin so‘rang: Nima qilishim kerak?

scenes.title: Namuna rol o‘yini
board: I have a cough and a sore throat.
Doctor: You should rest and drink water.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. I have a cough and a sore throat. My head hurts. It started two days ago. What should I do? Shifokor: you should rest, drink a lot of water and take some tablets. Sizning variantingiz boshqa bo‘lishi mumkin. Asosiysi, have bilan, hurts bilan gap va should bilan maslahat bo‘lsa, siz bugungi darsni bajardingiz.
scenes.say: I have a cough and a sore throat. My head hurts. It started two days ago. What should I do?
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘talim va tomoq og‘rig‘im bor. Boshim og‘riyapti. Ikki kun oldin boshlandi. Nima qilishim kerak?

scenes.title: Qisqacha takrorlash
board: I have a headache. My head hurts.
How long? It started two days ago.
You should rest. You must see a doctor.
Do you have anything for a cough?
Take two tablets twice a day.
scenes.say_native: Darsni yakunlaymiz. A’zo nomlarini o‘rgandik, I have a headache va my head hurts qoliplarini bildik. Shifokor savollariga javob berishni, should bilan maslahat va must bilan qat’iy talabni ajratishni o‘rgandik. Dorixonada do you have anything for deb so‘raymiz va take bilan doza aytamiz.
scenes.say: I have a headache. My head hurts. You should rest. You must see a doctor. Take two tablets twice a day.
scenes.say_uz: Boshim og‘riyapti. Dam olishingiz kerak. Shifokorga ko‘rinishingiz shart. Kuniga ikki marta ikkitadan tabletka iching.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: shifokor qabulini rol o‘yini sifatida o‘ynang yoki yozing. Bemor uchta simptomni aytsin, shifokor kamida ikkita maslahat bersin, should va must dan foydalansin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: gaplar to va s siz to‘g‘ri tuzilgan, have va hurts qoliplari ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda mehmonxona va sayohatda kerak bo‘ladigan iboralarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: role-play a doctor visit with three symptoms. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uchta simptom bilan shifokor qabulini o‘ynang. Yana ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Shifokor qabuli rol o‘yinini yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib ayting: bemor uchta simptomni aytsin, shifokor kamida ikkita maslahat (should va must) bersin. Mezon: have va hurts qoliplari to‘g‘ri, should dan keyin to yo‘q.

quiz.why_uz: Bosh og‘rig‘i: I have a headache.
Legs ko‘plik, shuning uchun fe’lda s yo‘q: hurt.
Should dan keyin to yoki ing bo‘lmaydi, fe’lning oddiy shakli.

quiz.q: In the pharmacy, which is the most polite?
options: Could I have some painkillers, please?
quiz.why_uz: Could I have ... please iltimosni muloyim qiladi.

quiz.q: You ___ drive. It is dangerous. (strong prohibition)
quiz.why_uz: Taqiq uchun mustn't: qat'iy man qilish.

quiz.q: What do you do with tablets?
quiz.why_uz: Dori uchun take fe'li ishlatiladi, drink emas.

quiz.q: Take one tablet ___ a day. (2 times)

options: It hurts here, in my back.
quiz.why_uz: Qayer? degan savolga joy bilan javob: here, in my back.

quiz.q: I feel ___. I want to be sick. (British)
quiz.why_uz: Britaniyada I feel sick, qusgim kelyapti degani.
